en: Colorized panoramic view of a town and military complex. In the foreground are residential buildings with red roofs and a distinctive round brick structure with a conical roof. Beyond this lie large barracks‑like buildings and open training fields, stretching into a flat rural landscape under a light sky. Red German text is printed at the top of the image indicating the place and the view toward specific barracks and an airfield.
